items.title: Introducing Hy4 Preview
items.summary: 腾讯发布Hy4预览版大语言模型，总参数量达770B，激活参数49B，支持100万token上下文窗口，模型文件1.56TB开源在Hugging Face。相比前代Hy3（295B总参数、21B激活参数、25.6万token上下文），参数规模与上下文能力均大幅提升。模型支持两种推理模式："high"（默认启用推理）和"no_think"（禁用推理）。
items.summary_en: Tencent released Hy4 Preview, an open-weight text-only LLM with 770B total parameters, 49B active parameters, and a 1M token context window (1.56TB on Hugging Face), marking a significant increase from Hy3's 295B total parameters and 256K context. The model features two reasoning modes—"high" (default) and "no_think"—with its reasoning traces using slightly truncated English, likely for token efficiency.

items.title: JetBrains/go-modern-guidelines
items.summary: JetBrains/go-modern-guidelines 是一个用于引导 AI 编码代理编写现代化 Go 代码的规则集，覆盖 Go 1.0 至 Go 1.27 特性，解决模型训练数据滞后和旧模式频率偏差问题。代理会优先使用 `max(a, b)`、`slices.Contains`、`cmp.Or`、`new(42)`、`errors.AsType[T]` 等现代惯用法。该指南已通过技能形式集成到 Junie、Claude Code、Codex 和 Cursor 等工具中，并在首次使用时自动安装 CLI 工具。
items.summary_en: JetBrains/go-modern-guidelines is a repository that provides AI coding agents with guidelines to write modern Go code, covering language features from Go 1.0 through Go 1.27. The tool detects the project's Go version via go.mod and ensures agents prefer modern idioms—such as max(), slices.Contains, errors.AsType[T] (Go 1.26), and new(42)—over outdated patterns caused by training data lag and frequency bias. Available for Junie, Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor, it runs via a CLI installed with go install that targets Go 1.25+ and stores guidance in a local cache without modifying the project.

items.summary: LiveKit Agents 是一个用于构建实时语音 AI 的智能体框架，支持 Deepgram、OpenAI、Cartesia 等多种 STT/LLM/TTS 提供商的灵活组合，并提供 MCP 原生支持与内置
items.summary_en: LiveKit Agents is an open-source framework for building realtime, multi-modal voice AI agents that can see, hear, and understand, supporting flexible integrations of STT, LLM, and TTS providers including Deepgram Nova-3, Google Gemma-4-31b-IT, and Cartesia Sonic-3. Key features include built-in job scheduling, semantic turn detection via transformer models, native MCP support, telephony integration, and a Builtin test framework, all running on LiveKit's open-source WebRTC media server. Install with pip using plugins like `livekit-agents[openai,deepgram,cartesia]`, and pair it with the LiveKit Docs MCP server and Agent Skill for AI coding assistant workflows.

items.title: AI Creates, AI Delivers, AI Fails — Quality Assurance for Unwatched Systems
items.summary: 作者构建了全自动AI Avatar流媒体系统，可在YouTube和Twitch无人值守运行——自动创建直播、调度GPU、用语音回复观众评论、到点关闭。核心挑战在于传统测试三大假设在此失效：输入不可预测、输出无固定正确答案、故障时系统仍在运行却无人察觉（即"活着但无功能"状态）。解决方案是从保证"输出正确"转向保证"系统行为"：定义到点停止条件、实现死亡传播机制（主动切断下游连接而非假装存活）、以及支持恢复并度量恢复时间，其中"主动终止Pod"成为最可靠的故障传递手段。
items.summary_en: The author built a fully automated AI avatar streaming system on YouTube and Twitch that runs without human intervention, but faced a critical QA challenge: traditional testing assumptions break down when input is unpredictable, LLM output is subjective, and failures don't crash the system—the stream keeps running silently. The solution was shifting from guaranteeing output correctness to guaranteeing system behavior, focusing on three principles: implementing explicit stop conditions (ending shows, terminating Pods on timeout, and self-termination on repeated renderer crashes), propagating upstream disconnections downstream rather than absorbing them, and ensuring layers recover and reconnect after failures.

directions.name: 万词文档问答助手
directions.description: 基于 Hy4 100万 token 长上下文能力的企业文档智能问答 SaaS，支持 PDF/Word/Markdown 等多格式上传与精准检索。
directions.description_en: An enterprise document Q&A SaaS built on Hy4's 1M token context, supporting multi-format uploads with precise retrieval.
directions.target_user: 律师、金融分析师、研究者等需要处理海量文档的专业人士
directions.target_user_en: Lawyers, financial analysts, researchers who handle large volumes of documents
core_features: 多格式文档（PDF/Word/Markdown）上传与自动切片摘要
基于 Hy4 长上下文的全文检索与多轮问答
支持推理模式（high）用于复杂分析、no_think 模式用于快速问答
core_features_en: Multi-format document upload with auto-chunking and summarization
Full-text search and multi-turn Q&A powered by Hy4's 1M token context
Dual inference modes: high for complex analysis, no_think for fast Q&A
directions.why_now: 腾讯 Hy4 发布 770B 总参数量 + 100万 token 上下文窗口，Hugging Face 上开源且文件达 1.56TB，相比前代 Hy3 上下文从 25.6万提升至 100万，推理链模式（high/no_think）提供灵活选择。社区对大模型成本敏感度高，开源替代方案需求旺盛；同时文档类工作负载（法律合同审查、学术文献梳理）对长上下文有强需求，Hy4 的低成本自部署让独立开发者能以极低边际成本服务企业客户。
directions.why_now_en: Tencent Hy4 brings 770B params and a 1M token context window, open-sourced on Hugging Face at 1.56TB. Context is 4x larger than Hy3 (256K→1M), with dual inference modes. Community shows strong demand for cost-effective open-source alternatives; document-heavy workflows (legal review, academic research) need long context, and self-hosting Hy4 enables independent developers to serve enterprises at near-zero marginal cost.
directions.monetization: SaaS 订阅制（按文档页数/查询次数分层定价），企业私有化部署一次性授权费
directions.monetization_en: SaaS subscription (tiered by document pages/query count), enterprise self-hosted deployment license fee

directions.name: Go 现代惯用法代码审查插件
directions.description: 为 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等 AI 编程助手提供 JetBrains/go-modern-guidelines 的 Go 代码审查与修复插件，自动将旧式 Go 代码升级为现代化写法。
directions.description_en: A linter and fix plugin for AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) that enforces JetBrains' go-modern-guidelines, auto-upgrading legacy Go patterns to idiomatic modern Go.
directions.target_user: Go 语言独立开发者、一人公司技术负责人、中小型 Go 团队
directions.target_user_en: Go indie developers, solo technical leads, small-to-medium Go teams
core_features: IDE 插件形式集成，实时高亮并推荐使用 slices.Contains、max()、cmp.Or 等现代惯用法
支持一键批量修复项目中的过时 Go 写法
生成团队代码规范报告，追踪现代化程度趋势
core_features_en: IDE plugin with real-time highlighting and suggestions for modern idioms like slices.Contains, max(), cmp.Or
One-click batch migration of legacy Go patterns across projects
Generate team code modernization reports with trend tracking
directions.why_now: JetBrains 于近期开源 go-modern-guidelines，覆盖 Go 1.0 至 Go 1.27，解决社区长期痛点：AI 编码代理训练数据滞后导致生成代码使用过时惯用法（如用 if a > b {max=a} 而非 max(a,b)）。该指南已集成至 Junie、Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等主流工具并自动安装 CLI，但缺少专门的审查/修复层。社区对 AI 生成代码质量担忧明显，Hacker News 和 Reddit r/golang 频繁讨论模型输出代码的可维护性问题，此时推出专注 Go 现代惯用法的工具正逢其时。
directions.why_now_en: JetBrains recently open-sourced go-modern-guidelines covering Go 1.0–1.27, addressing a long-standing community pain point: AI coding agents produce stale idioms due to lagging training data (e.g., if-statements instead of max(a,b)). The guidelines are integrated into Junie, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor with auto-installing CLI, but no dedicated review/fix layer exists yet. Active discussions on Hacker News and r/golang about AI-generated code maintainability make this the ideal timing for a Go-specific modernization tool.
directions.monetization: 个人免费 + Pro 版订阅（高级批量修复 + 团队规则配置），按席位收费
directions.monetization_en: Free for individuals, Pro subscription (advanced batch fixes + team rule config), per-seat pricing
